Liability for payment The tax imposed by this chapter shall be paid by the executor. (Aug. 16, 1954, ch. 736, 68A Stat. 374 ; Pub. L. 98–369, div. A, title V, §544(b)(1), July 18, 1984, 98 Stat. 894 ; Pub. L. 101–239, title VII, §7304(b)(2)(A), Dec. 19, 1989, 103 Stat. 2353 .)

entries: Pub. L. 101–239 substituted "The" for "Except as provided in section 2210, the".

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1989 Amendment
notes.effective_date: apply to estates of decedents dying after July 12, 1989.
notes.text: Pub. L. 101–239, title VII, §7304(b)(3), Dec. 19, 1989, 103 Stat. 2353 , provided that: "The amendments made by this subsection [amending this section and section 6018 of this title and repealing section 2210 of this title] shall apply to estates of decedents dying after July 12, 1989."

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1984 Amendment
notes.pub_law: Pub. L. 98–369, div. A, title V, §544(d)
notes.effective_date: apply to those estates of decedents which are required to file returns on a date (including any extensions) after the date of enactment of this Act [July 18, 1984].
notes.text: Pub. L. 98–369, div. A, title V, §544(d), July 18, 1984, 98 Stat. 894 , provided that: "The amendments made by this section [enacting section 2210 of this title and amending this section and sections 6018 and 6166 of this title] shall apply to those estates of decedents which are required to file returns on a date (including any extensions) after the date of enactment of this Act [July 18, 1984]."
